name: VolunTEEN Program (Children's Healthcare of Atlanta)
what_you_do: Volunteer in a children's hospital over the summer, at least one 3-hour shift a week for eight weeks. Placements are at Arthur M. Blank, Hughes Spalding or Scottish Rite hospitals.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 15 to 18. You must be at least 15 by the program start date (June 7 in 2027).
pay_detail: Unpaid. No cost stated on the page.
duration: 8 weeks in June and July (June 7 to July 31, 2027), one 3-hour day per week, no more than two missed days
deadline_text: Applications open Feb 1, 2027 at 10 a.m. and close Feb 5, 2027 at 4 p.m.
how_to_apply: Read the Volunteer Manual, pass the online volunteer assessment with at least 80 percent to unlock the application, then upload immunization records, photo ID copy, forms, 2 to 3 essays and the name of a non-family recommender. If selected, you do a virtual interview.
notes: Mandatory training June 2 or 3, 2027 with no make-up. Needs MMR, chickenpox, Tdap and flu shot (Aug 2026 or later) proof and willingness to get a TB blood test. The page also lists an Explorer career program (high school, no patient contact) that is being updated with no details yet, and a Youth Advisory Council for current and former patients ages 13 to 17.
